_help: Instagram media IDs listed under hidden are skipped by the sync and the build. Add an ID to hide a Reel from the site, remove it to show the Reel again. The value is a note for yourself. Trial Reels (is_shared_to_feed false in the API, not on the profile grid) are excluded automatically and kept in data/instagram.json as status excluded-trial; list one here only if the automatic check ever misses it.
